title: Label: Label for input (daisyUI)
notes:
Label is used to provide a name or title for an input field. Label can be placed before or after the field.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/label/+page.md
